headline: Zinc Miners Diverge as Nexa Slides 1.1% and Teck Resources Rises 1.2%
summary: Nexa Resources, which operates zinc mines in Peru and Brazil, fell 1.09% to $11.82 in New York trading. Meanwhile, Canadian miner Teck Resources climbed 1.22% to $63.04.
why: Zinc is primarily consumed in steel galvanizing; mining share performance reflects operational efficiencies and regional exposure across the Americas.

impacts.name: Nexa Resources S.A.
impacts.why: Nexa shares declined in New York trading alongside softer regional market sentiment.
